deviations.what: t19 verification: under Ghostty, bash-preexec (sourced by ghostty.bash) always places __bp_precmd_invoke_cmd ahead of __nvsh_hook, so the 'nvsh first in PROMPT_COMMAND' criterion cannot hold there and PIPESTATUS reaches the hook as a single element (false | true -> 0). Fix: __nvsh_hook reads BP_PIPESTATUS when bash-preexec ran first (it preserves $? and exposes the copy); the t19 criterion becomes 'nvsh hook present once, and pipeline PIPESTATUS correct with and without bash-preexec'
deviations.reason:
measured on spark with a copy of the real rc: declare -p PROMPT_COMMAND=[0]=$'__bp_precmd_invoke_cmd
__nvsh_hook
__fig_post_prompt
__bp_interactive_mode'; NVSH_HOOK_DEBUG_FILE shows 0<TAB>0 for 'false | true'

deviations.what: v1: under Ghostty the failing command's 133;D arrives after __nvsh_hook runs, so capture._locate_last_region falls back to the previous command's C..D region and the agent diagnoses the wrong output; fix: treat the last open C.. region (C after the last D) as the current command's slice
deviations.reason: observed on spark: nvsh context --show reported the previous command's output for ls /nope; thor/orin correct because nvsh owns OSC 133 there

deviations.what: operator on orin: a failing command produced 'nvsh: HTTP 401 invalid_api_key' because openai-compat only reads its bearer from the env var named by api_key_env, which is exported nowhere in a real interactive shell; the second failure printed nothing (silent rate limit). Fix: [agents.<name>] api_key_file = <0600 path> (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nvsh/api_key when present) read by the adapter and doctor, never logged; the rate limiter prints one line saying it held back and how to ask manually

deviations.what: operator on spark: in the one-shot pi fallback, Enter on a proposal does nothing because client._proposal_handler answers via client_transport.respond_ui (a daemon control message) while the agent runs in-process, so pi's approval dialog is never answered; also pi's rpc lifecycle events (agent_start, turn_start, message_start/end, tool bash) leak into the panel as '... <name>' status lines. Fix: the handler answers whichever agent owns the dialog (in-process responder in one-shot), and lifecycle events are not rendered as status
deviations.reason: reported by the operator from a live spark Ghostty session: proposal rendered, Enter had no visible effect

deviations.what: operator on spark: after one shell's Ctrl+G /ask turn (t19 test at 18:01) stayed active in the daemon, every later failure request from other shells queued behind it and hit the client timeout ('daemon connection lost: timed out') for 15+ minutes while 'nvsh daemon status' answered instantly; the daemon serializes agent requests with no per-request wall-clock cap, no abort when the requesting client disconnects, and no cancel of a pending approval dialog whose client is gone. Fix: abort the backend turn and cancel its dialog when the client socket closes, cap a turn at a configurable wall clock, and keep control requests out of the queue
deviations.reason: daemon status at 18:15 showed 5 shells, 1 agent, conversation 3422579 active with 1 request since 18:01; later shells never got a 'new conversation' log line

deviations.what: operator on spark: no progress indication while the agent works (tens of seconds of silence after the header), no acknowledgement line after choosing Enter/e/d/Esc on a proposal, and no clear line when the client falls back from the daemon; the panel prints text only when the backend emits it. Fix: an elapsed-time waiting line that repaints in place on a tty while no event has arrived for >1 s (no repaint when not a tty/NO_COLOR/dumb), an immediate acknowledgement after every proposal key (running / explaining / details / ignored), and a one-line 'falling back: <reason>' notice
deviations.reason: operator report from a live spark session: 'still took a lot of time, I don't see proper indications things run'

deviations.what: spark with the pi backend: every daemon-routed request logs 'new conversation for shell N' and then emits no event at all (no pi rpc process appears, no pi-sessions/shell-N.jsonl is created, daemon stderr is empty), so each panel and Ctrl+G waits the 120 s stream timeout and falls back to a one-shot that answers in ~6 s; the warm conversation is never used on the Spark. thor/orin (openai-compat) answer through the daemon in ~24 s. Fix: the daemon's pi adapter must start pi and surface any launch/turn failure as an ERROR event immediately
deviations.reason: t19b re-verification measured +120.4 s / +120.3 s cold and +120.1 s warm on spark; reproduced with a foreground daemon under private XDG dirs on the merged head

Fix: the pi adapter uses the assistant text streamed just before the tool call as the proposal's rationale, and when that is empty [e] asks the agent mid-turn ('explain this proposal in two sentences', same channel as steer) and streams the answer with a waiting indicator before re-showing the proposal
